title: Cross-implementation fixtures from JMAP.Net for Core + Calendars types
description: JMAP-Net/JMAP.Net (C#, MIT, models/serialization only, no runtime) independently implements JMAP Core + Calendars types. Use it once as an oracle: a small C# program builds Session, Calendar, CalendarEvent (+ ParticipantIdentity, notification) objects and serializes them; commit the JSON as fixtures under crate-jmap-calendars-types (and jmap-types for Core); Rust tests deserialize, assert fields, and compare round-trip. Optional reverse direction (Rust output through the C# deserializer). Tests stay offline; no .NET in CI (compute once, hardcode). On disagreement, the draft text (calendars-33 / RFC 8620) is the arbiter, not either implementation; file upstream if JMAP.Net is wrong. Motivation: today's serde bugs (isDraft/useDefaultAlerts/isOrigin presence, defaults) were in exactly this area.
